name: Erocas! ~Jikkyo! Inran Hoken'i~
original_name: エロキャス！～実況！淫乱保険医～
source:
The story begins when the protagonist, Nogami Masato, who worked at a hospital was caught having sex with Suzumoto Eri, and both of them got fired. 

Masato has a hobby of filming a POV pornography when he is having sex with women and collects those videos, occasionally earns a little money by broadcasting them. Without his job at the hospital, it becomes difficult for him to find women for his videos, so he turns his attention to a certain high school.

He successfully entered the school with Eri, and sets his sights on the school's popular and beautiful insurance doctor​ who also has a secret hidden within her.

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1191265]Getchu[/url]]
